title: Case Converter
h1: Case Converter — Change Text Case Instantly
seoTitle: Free Case Converter — Upper, Lower, Title & More
description: Convert any text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case or kebab-case. Private and free in your browser.
intro: Paste text and choose a case style. Conversion happens instantly on your device with no uploads.
blurb: Switch text between common case styles in one click — free and private.
howItWorks: Paste or type your text into the input box.
Select the desired case style from the dropdown.
Click Convert to see the transformed text. Everything runs locally in your browser.
examples: "hello world" to Title Case becomes "Hello World".
Use snake_case for variable names or kebab-case for CSS classes and slugs.

faq.q: Is my text uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All conversion happens entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your text never leaves your device.
Title Case capitalizes the first letter of each word, which is common for headings, titles, and button labels.

faq.q: Does it handle punctuation and multiple spaces?
faq.a: Yes. Basic punctuation is preserved where sensible, and the converters clean extra whitespace for readable results.
